title: Skill conformance declaration 1.1
description: A skill's claim about which parts of the portfolio standard it implements. Every claim is verified against disk by scripts/check_conformance.py — a declaration is a claim, not proof (D-WS3-05). 1.1 adds emit_check_input so the emits_core_artefact claim is behaviourally verifiable (gap 5 closure).

tier.description: full = findings-based rule validator; structural = artefact schema + completeness check. Both are legitimate, finished tiers: a deliberately scoped structural validator is not a placeholder for full. full is opt-in, not mandatory (D-WS3-06, revisited 2026-09-24).

validator.description: Repo-relative-to-skill path to validate.py. This schema only checks the value is a string — it does not check the path exists on disk; scripts/check_conformance.py verifies it against disk.

artefact_schema.description: Repo-relative-to-skill path to the artefact JSON Schema. This schema only checks the value is a string — it does not check the path exists on disk; scripts/check_conformance.py verifies it against disk.

sources_lock.description: Repo-relative-to-skill path to sources.lock.json. This schema only checks the value is a string — it does not check the path exists on disk; scripts/check_conformance.py verifies it against disk.

emit_check_input.description: Repo-relative-to-skill path to a known-good native sidecar. When emits_core_artefact is true, scripts/check_conformance.py runs `<validator> <emit_check_input> --emit-core-artefact <tmp>` and validates the emitted document against skill-artefact-1.1.schema.json with a FormatChecker (§9.1). Required exactly when emits_core_artefact is true.
